description: Implementation of a String type with functions for addition, comparison, matching, and conversion, used within the CEL-Go project for handling string values and operations.

classes.name: String
classes.description: A string type supporting various operations such as addition, comparison, matching, and conversion within the CEL-Go framework.

methods.name: ConvertToNative
methods.description: Converts the String to native Go types or protobuf representations.

methods.name: ConvertToType
methods.description: Converts the String to other CEL types like int, uint, double, bool, etc.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks equality between two String values.

methods.name: IsZeroValue
methods.description: Returns true if the String is empty.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Performs regex matching against the String.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Handles function overloads like contains, endsWith, startsWith.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the length of the String in runes.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the CEL type of the String.
